headline: FAA blames ground stop on telecom upgrade; Anthropic IPO nears; Nvidia investors urge Huang's return

austin.headline: Austinites get bluebonnet tattoos after the election
austin.summary: Some Austin residents marked the Democratic midterm results with bluebonnet tattoos as a show of Texas pride.

austin.headline: Austin weighs updates to stay an age-friendly city
austin.summary: City Hall is considering changes to its action plan for older residents.

texas.headline: Dow wins approval for four advanced nuclear reactors in Texas
texas.summary: Regulators approved the chemical maker's plan, developed with X-energy, for four reactors at its Seadrift site.

texas.headline: Texas Democrats outline plans to regulate data centers
texas.summary: Incoming Democratic lawmakers described how they want to oversee the growth of AI data centers in the state.

texas.headline: Texas becomes a major 2028 battleground after blue wave
texas.summary: The state's electoral votes are now seen as a top prize for both parties in the next presidential race.

us.headline: FAA blames ground stop on equipment fault during telecom upgrade
us.summary: The agency said Friday's nationwide halt was caused by an equipment issue during a network upgrade, and the transportation secretary tied it to contractor work on an L3Harris system.

us.headline: Speaker Johnson sees no need for an investigation into the ground stop
us.summary: The House speaker said he does not believe a probe of the FAA halt is necessary.

us.headline: Bomb found near Illinois ethanol plant prompts evacuations
us.summary: Residents near a central Illinois ethanol plant were evacuated after an explosive device was discovered.

us.headline: Judge pauses Trump plan to redevelop Washington public golf course
us.summary: A federal judge temporarily blocked the administration from closing East Potomac Park and moving ahead with the project.

us.headline: Democrat Kreiss-Tomkins wins Alaska governor's race
us.summary: Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins will replace a Republican and become the state's youngest governor.

us.headline: Schumer allies predict he will win over 40 votes in leadership race
us.summary: Supporters expect the Democratic leader to fend off Chris Van Hollen's challenge, while Sen. Fetterman criticised the challenger.

australia.headline: Australia signs defence deal with the Philippines
australia.summary: The two countries have formalised a new defence agreement.

australia.headline: Labor and Liberals launch Victorian election campaigns
australia.summary: Both major parties held campaign launches with pledges on health and youth crime as polling day nears.

australia.headline: Protesters target proposed Adelaide Hills data centre
australia.summary: Residents rallied against a data centre company's plans in South Australia.

australia.headline: Kangaroos and Jillaroos win Rugby League World Cup titles
australia.summary: Australia's men beat New Zealand in the final after the women's team claimed a fourth world title.

ai.headline: Anthropic's IPO arrives as AI stocks seek a lift
ai.summary: The AI company's share listing, expected to begin trading Nov. 19 at a reported $70 to $78 range, is seen as a test for a shaken AI trade.

ai.headline: Two big Nvidia investors urge board to weigh Huang's return
ai.summary: In a letter, the shareholders asked directors to consider bringing back the departed chief executive.

ai.headline: Commerce Department pressed over delayed Nvidia chip export controls
ai.summary: The department faces criticism for holding off on export restrictions covering Nvidia chips.

ai.headline: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for agent purchases
ai.summary: The new feature lets ChatGPT's AI agents buy things on users' behalf.

tech.headline: SpaceX catches Starship on return to launch tower
tech.summary: The company caught its Starship vehicle with the tower's arms in a historic milestone for the program.

tech.headline: SpaceX plans $24 billion data center project at Starbase
tech.summary: The company intends to build a large data center and power plant at its South Texas site.

world.headline: Zelenskyy warns US-floated security framework could help Putin
world.summary: Ukraine's president said a proposed new European security arrangement might benefit Russia.

world.headline: Trump's shifting Iran stance leaves Middle East unsure of US path
world.summary: Changing rhetoric from the president after the US elections has left the region uncertain about Washington's next steps.

aus-cricket.headline: England hand Australia a record ODI defeat in Adelaide
aus-cricket.summary: A top-order collapse led to Australia's heaviest one-day loss to England in the second match of the series.

aus-cricket.headline: NSW hand South Australia third straight Shield loss
aus-cricket.summary: New South Wales dominated to win their round-four Sheffield Shield match.

aus-cricket.headline: Queensland beat Tasmania for first Shield win of the season
aus-cricket.summary: The Bulls completed victory on day four, and a Tasmanian fast bowler was called into the ODI squad.

aus-cricket.headline: Brisbane Heat crush Hobart Hurricanes by 10 wickets
aus-cricket.summary: The Heat cruised to an emphatic WBBL win in Hobart.
